notes: Generated from canonical DDS component rules; source stylesheets are not rewritten.
Tokens, light/dark values and fonts remain in tokens.css and are inherited.
Document shells, prose, inventories, gallery frames and scaled preview overrides are excluded.
Example-only centering, wrappers and margins remain with document frames rather than service components.
:root selectors preserve their original specificity plus the scope through .dds-ui.dds-ui.
Body rules become scope typography only. #toast becomes the scoped .dds-toast runtime host.
Animation identifiers are namespaced to prevent host-animation collisions; timing and frames are unchanged.
Popups and tooltips must remain descendants of a .dds-ui or .dds-ui.dds-ui-portal wrapper.
Canonical document hooks and the service hook aliases exported by ui/source.js share each state rule.
component-layout.css defines reusable fill/content sizing. Document-only caps, centering and outer spacing live in component-specimens.css, which is not part of this stylesheet or the SDK.
Choose tokens.css or ui/tokens-scoped.css once. Scoped tokens belong only to outermost DDS boundaries, inherit through nested components, and leave host variables unchanged.
